review_type: Non-blind internal field-general logic/readability review, followed by bounded verification of three authorized repairs.
exposure_disclosure: Reviewer authored related_work.tex and revised references.bib; previously audited benchmark and seven-system/head evidence and wrote the data chapter of the coauthor dossier. This is not paper-blind, external author-independent, or a venue-calibrated assessment. The reviewer examined their own related-work attribution gap.

inputs.initial_hash_check: All 16 files matched the fixed manifest before review corrections. Changes listed below are authorized subsequent repairs; the fixed manifest is retained.

reading_coverage.static_ref_and_citation_scan: main.tex, all sections, and all tables
reading_coverage.numeric_reuse: Previous independently verified 54 main-table values/max flags, 6 support-operation counts and 4 differences, 42 head endpoints, and 8 pair values. This review did not re-score examples or inspect every cell of all remaining supplement tables.
reading_coverage.pdf_layout: Not assessed in this round; parent handles compiled PDF.

overall.scientific_assessment: The contribution chain and principal descriptive findings are supported for the evaluated development scope. Three bounded reporting/attribution repairs were required; all three are now present in the source. No new experiments are needed to address this review.
overall.submission_readiness: Scientific logic/readability review passes after the local repairs; named-venue compliance, author declarations and final PDF layout remain separately owned checks.

dimensions.rationale: The contribution is a curated functional benchmark, complete seven-configuration diagnosis, and executable operation-based controller; it does not depend on a first/SOTA claim. The nearest executable-guideline precedent and the rules source were missing; M2 restores their attribution.
dimensions.uncertainty: Literature coverage is bounded, not a systematic novelty certification.
dimensions.decision_impact: Resolved by local citation and two related-work sentences.

dimensions.rationale: Units, overlapping targets, native inputs, scoring mappings, aggregation, baseline identities, deterministic routing, controls and exposure are distinguishable. A1/A2 partitions and set-update formula are coherent. A3 prose defines prior construction, coefficient, voting and tie breaking sufficiently. Annotation actor provenance was missing; M1 now states language-model agents performed annotation/review.
dimensions.uncertainty: No independent clinician agreement or unseen-family confirmation is claimed; those studies are not supplied by this manuscript.
dimensions.decision_impact: Resolved existing-information reporting gap; no new experiment requested.

dimensions.rationale: Complete seven-system/head coverage and full-controller gains lead the evidence. The constant-None prior, limited calibration increment, small clinical R4 regression, separate supplied-model panel and opposing verifier effects are visible. M3 corrects one unsupported secondary paragraph title; the numerical control and main conclusions remain valid.
dimensions.uncertainty: Existing score audits are reused; current review did not repeat inference or scoring. Within-family intervals do not remove development selection.
dimensions.decision_impact: No principal result needs removal or replacement.

dimensions.rationale: Medical change sensitivity motivates the five relations; the curated benchmark exposes distinct seven-system deficits; targeted operations feed sparse CF-MoA; two full configurations test integration. The later verifier is correctly subordinate to the main contribution. The work reads as a research paper rather than the experiment chronology.
dimensions.uncertainty: A4 remains a conditional component with zero clinical-v5 activation, stated clearly and evaluated separately.

dimensions.rationale: Definitions precede internal symbols, sections lead with results, and the main text directly presents supported gains. Broad qualifications are mostly consolidated. Three small optional reductions/precision edits are listed below; none requires defensive expansion.
dimensions.uncertainty: Source readability and prior figure inspection only; no final PDF layout verdict.

must_fix_findings.minimum_repair: Add one direct annotation-actor sentence in the construction paragraph, retaining the existing distinctions among semantic review, grouped review and structural verification. Do not invent annotator-model versions or a clinician panel.
must_fix_findings.resolution: benchmark.tex:23 now begins: Language-model agents performed structured semantic annotation and review, supported by cross-checks and targeted audits.
must_fix_findings.verification: Read the changed paragraph; the existing limitations statement on absent clinician agreement is retained.

optional_suggestions.edit: After the metric equation add We report these means as percentages. In limitations replace independent deployment conditions with unseen case families; a family-disjoint study alone is not a deployment evaluation.
optional_suggestions.reason: Small scale and generalization-target precision improvements.
